title: Security hygiene follow-ups from the 2026-11 review (twelve small items)

criteria.then: the admin-only diagnostics rule covers the trailing-slash spelling (/rest/saiku/info/diagnostics/**) so an anonymous request there is stopped by the URL rule (401), not by the Jersey annotation (403)
DemoGateResource records a limiter hit for every send BEFORE the provider dial, not only when sendCode throws
the default servlet's dirAllowed init-param is false, so a directory URL answers 403, not a listing

criteria.given: two dashboard paths differing only by / versus _
criteria.then: their comment and history sidecars derive from a hash of the exact path (DashboardSidecars), so they are DIFFERENT files; reads fall back to the legacy sanitised name and the first write retires it

criteria.given: the email health and self-send endpoints
criteria.then: the operator's selfTo address is echoed only to ROLE_ADMIN callers (health omits it, self-send stops echoing it); other callers get the configured booleans / a plain sent status

criteria.given: the admin invite and multi-recipient send endpoints
criteria.then: both dial only after the stored SMTP host passes SmtpHostValidator (env-managed relays trusted as-is), like the test-send endpoint already does
it covers NAT64 64:ff9b::/96, 6to4 2002::/16 (via its embedded IPv4) and IPv4-compatible ::a.b.c.d (via its embedded IPv4)
cells are capped at MAX_CELL_BYTES stringified (marked when truncated) and reading stops once the whole result passes MAX_RESULT_BYTES, reporting truncated

criteria.given: the Google Sheets add-on's setValues path
criteria.then: toSheetValues neutralises strings starting with =, +, - or @ with a leading apostrophe, in headers and cell values

measure/cube are plain names, level/member/payerLevel/trendLevel must be full MDX unique names, the member must be on the level, and the create/write/re-query/restore sequence is serialised per connection
it answers 403 unless the caller holds ROLE_ADMIN — the static SDL (which names elements Mondrian roles may hide) is not served to ordinary users
the saiku-ui webResources copy excludes *.map, so no JavaScript source map ships under /ui/
